dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Hmm, Clitopho? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Yes. He used to sell fake medicines above ground. He'd go around advertising this "Real Man's Meds" nonsense, only for the workers to buy it and find that it was just Valberry Jam.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Well, not that it was harmful, and it was cheap and pretty tasty. It was chilled in ice, too, so it was, all things considered, a way better deal than drinks purchased from a long way off in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: So, you've fallen in with the Treasure Hoarders in the meantime, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Um, you could say that... Kind of. Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: How did you know that he...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Haha! You've got a lot to learn, kiddo. I didn't spend 20-odd years of my life down in these mines for nothing, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: You can wash the soot off your face, but you can't change the color your hands are dyed.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Alright then. Tell me, what can you do? We don't feed idlers around here.

choices.text: He claims that he can make explosives.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Well now, guess that alchemy you learned has finally been put to some use, huh? Well, we do need a demolitions team at the moment.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Wait. Didn't we get in touch with a demolitions expert from Mondstadt? Why do we need to count on him?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Oh, you mean her? So, Muning received an apology letter just this morning, saying that the kid had blown the stove right off this restaurant called "Good Hunter" and got grounded as a result...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Even her... guardian, I guess? This guy called the Cavalry Captain, I think. Either way, he got grounded too, and he was supposed to come with her.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I'm not sure what this is. Maybe it's some kind of code for people in Mondstadt? Either way, she's not coming.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, who might that be...?

choices.text: Should we call this fortune... Or misfortune?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: #Hmph, so even you think so huh, {NICKNAME}? Well, I guess it's your lucky day, Clitopho.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Come on, Zhiqiong. Clitopho here's from Mondstadt, so he's not too far off the mark from what we were looking for. He'll serve.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Thank you, Jinwu! Thanks so much! So... I guess I count as a member of the team now?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Once you've proved your worth.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, I've got no faith in this fellow. The demolitions team is a key appointment. Lives will be at stake! And we're giving this to a Treasure Hoarder...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Oh, quit your yammering, you.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I've known this kid way longer than you have. He's not a bad person. Never had the courage to, anyway. Just give him some time.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: So, other than meeting some new friends, were you here for anything else?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, the path to the lower levels has been sealed off by stone, so we're going to use the "Mountainator" to clear that path.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Pfft. The Mountainator, eh? Hahaha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What are you laughing about?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Pfft, sorry. Heh. I mean, call me old fashioned, but in the Engineering Department, we all called this the Safe Blasting Mechanism 2156.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: But I suppose Mountainator works too. It's a cute nickname, no doubt.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: If you want to use that cannon... Eh, it's a shame I wasn't part of the demolition crew, and I need to take care of the camp over here. Still, I think that you should be able to find a manual nearby.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Ah, right. I also believe that the keys to the facility should also have been hidden separately in two different water filtration devices. Let me mark them out on the map for you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what? Isn't that the same as hiding your house keys under the doormat? What kind of security measure is that?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Well, you say that, but The Chasm was never a place that ordinary people could access. Even if people with other intentions entered...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: It's not entirely likely that they would immediately think to find the two keys in such obvious places. Am I right, my Treasure Hoarder friend?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Ugh... Well, Erge wasn't able to find the storehouse keys, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: What? That idiot doesn't count. But anyway, I need to continue working on these maps... So I leave Clitopho to you guys.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're not worried about him?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hmph, I'll keep a close watch on him. Who knows if he's got some poisonous plan against us. Even if Jinwu trusts him, I won't let my guard down...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I can't be at ease until he's in the hands of the Millelith... Keep an eye on this guy. Don't even give him a chance to try anything.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Alright, now that you know where the storehouse keys are, don't disturb me any further, alright?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}. You must have seen some raw Lumenstone ore on the way here, right?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: If you need to, come look for me and I'll help you polish 'em up. They're actually pretty good as adjuvants down in this place.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: They seem to have the power to restrain the encroachment of that black mud-like substance, almost as if they were born to be enemies. The principle of how that works escapes me, though.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Haha, what can I say? I'm just not all that learned outside my profession. But once you see "that thing," I think you'll understand.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Hahahahaha! Stop kidding! Hahahaha!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hey, come on!

choices.text: Clitopho here might actually be the safer choice...
He mucked up every job the Hoarders gave him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hahahaha! Really! In what world does that count?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Of course it doesn't.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Uh, does making explosives count?
